git.not_connected: This collection isn't connected to a Git repository.
git.credentials_invalid: The username or token is too long.
git.interval_invalid: The check interval can be 1, 6 or 24 hours.
git.token_unreadable: The saved access token can't be decrypted. A workspace admin must enter the token again.
git.behind: The repository has changes you haven't pulled yet. Pull them with "Pull from repo" first, then push.
git.secrets_suspected: The repository may receive values that shouldn't be there: {warnings} Check them; confirm if you still want to push.
git.remote_moved: The repository changed after the preview. View the diff again.
git.conflicts: {count} items were changed differently on both sides. Choose which one to keep for each.
git.id_in_use: '{name}' uses the ID of another collection; remove the "id" field from the file.
git.url_chars: The repository URL contains invalid characters. Don't put a username or password in it; enter the access token in its own field.
git.url_canonical: The repository URL must be written in canonical form (e.g. https://github.com/company/repo.git).
git.url_ipv4_mapped: IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses aren't supported; write the IPv4 address directly.
git.path_invalid: The folder path is invalid; enter a relative path inside the repository (e.g. api/collections).
git.host_warning: This request's URL changes from {from} to {to}; authorization secrets will be sent to the new server using the real values stored locally.
git.duplicate_id: The same ID ({id}) is used in more than one file.
git.secret_example_jwt: {name}: the "{example}" example response contains a JWT-like value.
git.secret_header: {name}: the "{header}" header has a hard-coded value; use {hint} instead.
git.secret_url: {name}: the URL contains a hard-coded key/token parameter.
git.secret_form: {name}: the "{field}" form field has a hard-coded value.
gitsync.auto_check_disabled: Automatic checking was turned off because of repeated errors.
